pertanyaan: Tampilkan data capaian UPT berdasarkan jumlah laporan yang dikirimkan ke pusat (tanggal ke
sql:
WITH latest_target_year AS (
    SELECT MAX(tahun) AS tahun_terbaru FROM target_balai
),
laporan_dikirim AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.nama_balai,
        mp.komoditi,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) AS tahun,
        COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan
    FROM mv_pengawasan mp
    WHERE mp.tgl_start IS NOT NULL
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY mp.nama_balai, mp.komoditi, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mp.tgl_start)
)
SELECT 
    ld.nama_balai,
    ld.komoditi,
    ld.tahun AS tahun_laporan,
    tb.tahun AS tahun_target,
    ld.jumlah_laporan,
    tb.target_pengawasan,
    ROUND(
        (ld.jumlah_laporan::decimal / NULLIF(tb.target_pengawasan, 0)) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS capaian_persen
FROM laporan_dikirim ld
CROSS JOIN latest_target_year lty
LEFT JOIN target_balai tb 
    ON LOWER(TRIM(tb.nama_balai)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.nama_balai))
    AND LOWER(TRIM(tb.komoditi)) = LOWER(TRIM(ld.komoditi))
    AND tb.tahun = lty.tahun_terbaru
ORDER BY ld.nama_balai, ld.komoditi;

pertanyaan: Tampilkan data ketepatan waktu pelaporan oleh UPT yang dihitung berdasarkan laporan yang d
sql:
SELECT 
    mp.nama_balai,
    COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '8 day') 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS laporan_tepat_waktu,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '8 day') 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 
            END
        )::DECIMAL / COUNT(*) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS persentase_tepat_waktu
FROM mv_pengawasan mp
JOIN mv_pengawasan_timeline mpt 
    ON mp.id = mpt.id_pengawasan
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai) = 2025
GROUP BY mp.nama_balai
ORDER BY mp.nama_balai;

pertanyaan: Tampilkan persentase Penilaian Produk (UPT) berdasarkan TMK Mayor/TMK Minor  (baik secara
sql:
WITH data_penilaian AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.nama_balai,
        UPPER(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) AS kesimpulan_penilaian,
        COUNT(*) AS jumlah
    FROM mv_pengawasan mp
    WHERE 
        LOWER(mp.komoditi) LIKE '%pangan%'
        AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat IS NOT NULL
        AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mp.nama_balai, UPPER(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai)
)
SELECT 
    dp.nama_balai,
    dp.kesimpulan_penilaian,
    dp.jumlah,
    ROUND(
        (dp.jumlah::decimal / NULLIF(SUM(dp.jumlah) OVER (PARTITION BY dp.nama_balai), 0)) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS persentase
FROM data_penilaian dp
ORDER BY dp.nama_balai, persentase DESC;

pertanyaan: Berdasarkan kata kunci nama produsen tertentu, tampilkan berapa jumlah iklan yang dilapork
sql:
select 
    mp.pendaftar,
    count(*) as total_laporan,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat) = 'mk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_mk_pusat,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat) = 'tmk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_tmk_pusat,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) = 'mk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_mk_balai,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) = 'tmk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_tmk_balai,
    sum(case 
        when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) <> lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat)
             and mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai is not null 
             and mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat is not null 
        then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_perbedaan_balai_pusat
from mv_pengawasan mp 
where lower(mp.pendaftar) like '%kao indonesia%'
  and mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat is not null
group by mp.pendaftar
order by total_laporan desc;
